text: I see you have persistent vomiting and chest pain; to start, can you tell me if your chest pain radiates to your jaw or left arm, and does it worsen with deep breaths? REQUEST TEST: Electrocardiogram (ECG) to rule out cardiac ischemia or pulmonary embolism.
